title: orbitopt multi-spacecraft unified replay document v1.0
description: Two or more spacecraft trajectories sampled onto ONE shared time axis, ready to replay together (E12-01, task #391). Produced by orbitopt.mission.multispacecraft.build_unified_replay from a validated MultiSpacecraftMission plus per-spacecraft BodyTracks. All times are SI seconds (the 's' suffix on every time field is the unit contract) counted on the shared TDB seconds since J2000 axis -- absolute, leap-second- and TDB-TT-aware via Epoch.to_tdb_seconds, so two tracks authored on different declared timescales land on the same number. Every sample carries its own 't_tdb_s' and every spacecraft carries its frame, so a reader never has to assume alignment. Structural rules JSON Schema can express live here; axis ordering, per-track bracketing and event placement are checked by orbitopt.mission.multispacecraft.

frame.description: The mission's single frame; every position/velocity in this document (samples and relative states) is in it.

time_axis_tdb_s.description: The shared, strictly increasing TDB-seconds axis. Per-spacecraft samples land on the overlap window of the tracks; events may fall anywhere on the axis.

spacecraft.description: One entry per roster spacecraft: its role and its resampled state.

relative_states.description: Target-referenced relative state at every axis sample (one per CHASER, at every axis time inside its overlap window). Optional for readers, but build_unified_replay always fills it when there is exactly one TARGET.

events.description: The mission events placed on the shared axis (t_tdb_s), in ascending time order.

frame.description: Always the mission frame (the validator rejected any other).

t_tdb_s.description: Absolute TDB seconds since J2000 -- an axis time inside this spacecraft's own track coverage.
Event epoch placed on the shared axis.
